notes.text: (1) 1 Corinthians iv. 20. (2) Psalm xciv. 10. (3) Zephaniah i. 12. (4) 1 Corinthians iv. 5.

verses.text: “My Son, let not the fair and subtle sayings of men move thee.
verses.modernizedText: “My Son, do not let the pleasing and subtle sayings of men move you.

verses.text: For the kingdom of God is not in word, but in power.(1) Give ear to My words, for they kindle the heart and enlighten the mind, they bring contrition, and they supply manifold consolations.
verses.modernizedText: For the kingdom of God is not in word, but in power.(1) Listen to My words, for they kindle the heart and enlighten the mind; they bring contrition and provide many consolations.

verses.text: Never read thou the word that thou mayest appear more learned or wise; but study for the mortification of thy sins, for this will be far more profitable for thee than the knowledge of many difficult questions.
verses.modernizedText: Never read the word so that you may appear more learned or wise; instead, study for the mortification of your sins, for this will be far more profitable to you than knowing many difficult questions.

verses.text: “When thou hast read and learned many things, thou must always return to one first principle.
verses.modernizedText: “When you have read and learned many things, you must always return to one first principle.

verses.text: I am He that teacheth man knowledge,(2) and I give unto babes clearer knowledge than can be taught by man.
verses.modernizedText: I am He who teaches man knowledge,(2) and I give little children clearer knowledge than man can teach.

verses.text: He to whom I speak will be quickly wise and shall grow much in the spirit.
verses.modernizedText: He to whom I speak will quickly become wise and grow much in the spirit.

verses.text: Woe unto them who inquire into many curious questions from men, and take little heed concerning the way of My service.
verses.modernizedText: Woe to those who ask men about many curious questions and pay little attention to the way of My service.

verses.text: The time will come when Christ will appear, the Master of masters, the Lord of the Angels, to hear the lessons of all, that is to examine the consciences of each one.
verses.modernizedText: The time will come when Christ, the Master of masters, the Lord of the Angels, will appear to hear everyone's lessons, that is, to examine each conscience.

verses.text: And then will He search Jerusalem with candles,(3) and the hidden things of darkness(4) shall be made manifest, and the arguings of tongues shall be silent.
verses.modernizedText: And then He will search Jerusalem with candles,(3) and the hidden things of darkness(4) will be made known, and the arguments of tongues will fall silent.

verses.text: “I am He who in an instant lift up the humble spirit, to learn more reasonings of the Eternal Truth, than if a man had studied ten years in the schools.
verses.modernizedText: “I am He who in an instant lifts up the humble spirit to learn more of the reasonings of Eternal Truth than a person could learn by studying ten years in the schools.

verses.text: I teach without noise of words, without confusion of opinions, without striving after honour, without clash of arguments.
verses.modernizedText: I teach without noise of words, without confusion of opinions, without striving for honor, without a clash of arguments.

verses.text: I am He who teach men to despise earthly things, to loathe things present, to seek things heavenly, to enjoy things eternal, to flee honours, to endure offences, to place all hope in Me, to desire nothing apart from Me, and above all things to love Me ardently.
verses.modernizedText: I am He who teaches people to despise earthly things, to loathe present things, to seek heavenly things, to enjoy eternal things, to flee honors, to endure offenses, to place all hope in Me, to desire nothing apart from Me, and above all to love Me ardently.

verses.text: “For there was one, who by loving Me from the bottom of his heart, learned divine things, and spake things that were wonderful; he profited more by forsaking all things than by studying subtleties.
verses.modernizedText: “For there was one who, by loving Me from the bottom of his heart, learned divine things and spoke wonderful things; he gained more by forsaking all things than by studying subtleties.

verses.text: But to some I speak common things, to others special; to some I appear gently in signs and figures, and again to some I reveal mysteries in much light.
verses.modernizedText: But to some I speak of ordinary things, to others of special things; to some I appear gently in signs and figures, and to others I reveal mysteries in much light.

verses.text: The voice of books is one, but it informeth not all alike; because I inwardly am the Teacher of truth, the Searcher of the heart, the Discerner of the thoughts, the Mover of actions, distributing to each man, as I judge meet.”
verses.modernizedText: The voice of books is one, but it does not instruct everyone alike; because inwardly I am the Teacher of truth, the Searcher of the heart, the Discerner of thoughts, the Mover of actions, distributing to each person as I judge fitting.”
